self_check.method: Each description compared with the text of its own site, fetched with curl and, for JavaScript pages, rendered in Chromium. The site itself is the source. Claims the page text did not support were removed.

visual_review.method: Pages rendered in Chromium, screenshotted after loading (and after a click, hover or longer wait where the page needed it), and looked at. Descriptions were confirmed or rewritten to match what the page shows.

trusted.note: Accepted on the reliability of their source, never read against the site itself: anti-bot walls or a graphics card stopped every automated check. Shown as such in the app.
